parsers.name: Template Matcher
parsers.description: Matches logs against templates you supply and extracts the values at each <*> wildcard. Built for streaming.

parsers.name: Template Tree Matcher
parsers.description: Tree-based template matching — faster than the Template Matcher for batch workloads.

parsers.name: Drain
parsers.description: Derives templates from the logs themselves, following the Drain publication.

parsers.name: Auto Parser
parsers.description: Picks the best-matching regex and templates from a built-in dataset. No setup, but only for log types it already knows.

parsers.name: JSON Parser
parsers.description: Flattens JSON logs into dot-separated fields, and can hand one field on to a Template Matcher.

parsers.name: LogBatcher
parsers.description: Infers templates with any OpenAI-compatible LLM. No training data or labelled examples needed.
